sections.heading: Right of way, passing and turning
sections.markdown:
## Right of way, passing and turning

FACT_ID: sec04-R01 | anchor: A01
On a two-lane road, begin passing only in a marked passing zone and only with enough space to return fully to the right before the zone ends or an intersection is reached. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=19]

FACT_ID: sec04-R02 | anchor: A01
A two-lane passing maneuver must be completed before an approaching vehicle is within 200 feet of your vehicle. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=19]

FACT_ID: sec04-R03 | anchor: A01
Before pulling out to pass, check rear and side mirrors and look over the shoulder for the blind spot; make sure another vehicle is not already passing you. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=19]

FACT_ID: sec04-R04 | anchor: A01
Signal left before passing. Return right only when safely clear and able to see the passed vehicle in the rearview mirror; signal right for the return and cancel the signal afterward. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=19]

FACT_ID: sec04-R05 | anchor: A01
Do not pass on a two-lane road where the line on your side is solid yellow, where double yellow lines prohibit the move, or where a no-passing sign is posted. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=19]

FACT_ID: sec04-R06 | anchor: A01
On a two-lane road, passing is prohibited within 100 feet of a railroad crossing, bridge, viaduct or tunnel. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=19]

FACT_ID: sec04-R07 | anchor: A02
Do not pass where an oncoming vehicle makes the move unsafe, where a hill or curve hides approaching traffic, on the shoulder, or past a school bus stopped for passengers. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=20]

FACT_ID: sec04-R08 | anchor: A02
Driving left of the centerline to get around an obstruction is allowed only after yielding to oncoming traffic. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=20]

FACT_ID: sec04-R09 | anchor: A02
On a multilane two-way highway, do not cross left of the centerline except when signs or signals authorize it or when turning left into a private road, alley or driveway. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=20]

FACT_ID: sec04-R10 | anchor: A02
Passing on the right is allowed beside a vehicle turning or preparing to turn left when the pavement has room for both vehicles, or on a highway with at least 2 same-direction lanes. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=20]

FACT_ID: sec04-R11 | anchor: A02
When being passed, do not accelerate until the passing vehicle has completely cleared you. A slight speed reduction can help it finish; remain alert for unsafe actions. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=20]

FACT_ID: sec04-R12 | anchor: A02
Do not pass a vehicle stopped for a pedestrian at a marked crosswalk or an unmarked intersection crosswalk. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=20]

FACT_ID: sec04-R13 | anchor: A02
When stopping for a person in a crosswalk, leave enough space for other approaching drivers to see the entire crossing. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=20]

FACT_ID: sec04-R14 | anchor: A02
Approach an intersection with stopped vehicles slowly and ready to stop even if their signal permits travel; those vehicles may be screening a pedestrian from view. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=20]

FACT_ID: sec04-R15 | anchor: A02
Approach a bicycle cautiously and, when road and traffic conditions permit, change to a lane that is not adjacent to it before passing. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=20]

FACT_ID: sec04-R16 | anchor: A02
When traffic conditions or law prevent changing lanes to pass a bicycle, the passing vehicle must keep at least 3 feet away from the bicycle throughout the maneuver. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=20]

FACT_ID: sec04-R17 | anchor: A02
A motorcyclist is entitled to the entire lane. Pass in a neighboring lane rather than sharing the motorcycle's lane. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=20]

FACT_ID: sec04-R18 | anchor: A02
Weaving between lanes merely to outrun traffic is unlawful. Pass slower traffic only through safe lane changes with clear signals. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=20]

FACT_ID: sec04-R19 | anchor: A02
Signal continuously far enough before each left or right turn to warn other drivers; avoid abrupt last-moment turns. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=20]

FACT_ID: sec04-R20 | anchor: A02
Do not flash a turn signal to tell a following driver that it is safe to pass. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=20]

FACT_ID: sec04-R21 | anchor: A02
For a right turn, give advance notice, approach in the right lane near the curb or road edge, and yield to bicyclists continuing straight in a bicycle lane. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=20]

FACT_ID: sec04-R22 | anchor: A02
Finish a right turn in the right lane. Where several marked lanes turn together, finish in the corresponding receiving lane. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=20]

FACT_ID: sec04-R23 | anchor: A02
For a left turn, signal early and approach from the far-left lane in your direction or the provided turn lane. Keep the wheels straight until the turn begins. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=20]

FACT_ID: sec04-R24 | anchor: A02
Before a left turn, yield to opposing vehicles, including bicycles, and to pedestrians crossing either road. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=20]

FACT_ID: sec04-R25 | anchor: A02
When signs, signals and a safe opening permit the left turn, finish in the receiving lane nearest the centerline or center lanes. With multiple turn lanes, use the corresponding receiving lane. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=20]

FACT_ID: sec04-R26 | anchor: A02
After entering the intersection for a left turn, do not switch lanes within the intersection. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=20]

FACT_ID: sec04-R27 | anchor: A02
When turning into a road with pedestrians in its crosswalk, stop and remain stopped until they clear the lanes you will travel through. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=20]

Misconceptions: A green light or lawful priority does not make an unsafe entry safe; being passed does not permit accelerating to block it.
Mnemonic: Look, yield, signal, move, then clear.
Glossary: A blind spot is checked by looking beyond the mirror view; a receiving lane is the lane entered after a turn.
Dynamic-fact isolation: Penalty amounts and the bicycle-passing speed comparison retain explicit verification debt; source diagrams are not reproduced.
